P_calibration.quote: Note, however, that (B) is also the provision most likely to be used against workarounds like vessel-splitting (item 1).

P_holdback.quote: Counsel may want to separate the "unworkability" arguments to raise publicly (items 6, 9, 16, 26, 30, 34) from the "operating room" items to hold for post-enactment planning.

P_grandfather_step.quote: Only licenses issued before enactment qualify. That timing is relevant to any pending license applications.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Structuring around the thresholds or definitions carries exposure. The Sec. 2(1)(B) catch-all, anti-evasion doctrines, and 18 U.S.C. § 1001 ... could all be used against an aggressive structure.
